{{Conjecture|legends}}
Sometime between to [[49 BBY/Legends|49 BBY]] and [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Saidle Frex]] operated out of a '''base''' hidden within [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] ruins on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Frex, and his subordinates, utilized the facility to smuggle local [[Veermok/Legends|veermoks]] off-planet, to sell as guard-animals to criminals across the galaxy.

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Ali-Vor]] assigned his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Rann I-Kanu]], to investigate a rumored location of the base. I-Kanu, a student at Naboo's [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]] in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], enlisted the aid of three fellow students, [[Galak]], [[Arani Korden]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]] to assist him with the investigation. The group eventually discovered Frex's hideout, overwhelmed the smugglers, and defeated Frex himself, freeing a kidnapped House of Learning [[Professor/Legends|Professor]], [[Tasrah Boh]], in the process.
